snippet.title: Directive 8020 Developer Presentation - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
During this year's Spring Showcase, Legendary horror developers Supermassive Games dropped a brand-new trailer showcasing the multiplayer features present in Directive 8020. This latest entry in The Dark Pictures Anthology is coming to PC, PlayStation and Xbox on May 12 later this year.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2255370/Directive_8020/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
